Category bucket in which the repository was ranked (e.g. top-100-stars
Short name of the GitHub repository without owner prefix.
Number of GitHub stars, indicating repository popularity.
Number of times the repository has been forked by the community.
Primary programming language detected by GitHub for the repository.
Canonical GitHub web URL uniquely identifying the repository.

Number of open GitHub issues reported on the repository at snapshot time.
